title: Train BERTOS on OS-ICSD training set
action: Train a BERTOS model (BERT-based transformer token classification) on the OS-ICSD training set using the provided data splits and the training configuration from the BERTOS repository.
description: The agent must execute the training loop until reasonable convergence, producing a saved model checkpoint.

title: Generate OS-ICSD test set oxidation state predictions
action: Load the trained OS-ICSD BERTOS model, run inference on the OS-ICSD test set, and output per-atom predicted oxidation states alongside true labels.
description: Raw per-atom site predictions for the OS-ICSD test set; the primary artifact for recomputing headline accuracy.
output_schema: Columns: composition (string), element (string), true_oxidation_state (int), predicted_oxidation_state (int). One row per atom site in the test set.

title: Compute OS-ICSD evaluation metrics
action: Using the generated predictions, compute overall site-level accuracy, compound-level accuracy, and per-element site-level accuracies, and write the results to a JSON file.
description: Summary metrics for the OS-ICSD evaluation, including per-element breakdown.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: overall_site_accuracy (float, percent), compound_level_accuracy (float, percent), per_element_site_accuracy (object mapping element symbol to float percent).

title: Train BERTOS on OS-ICSD-oxide training set
action: Train a BERTOS model (same architecture) on the OS-ICSD-oxide training set using the provided oxide-specific data splits.
description: The agent must execute the training loop until reasonable convergence, producing a saved model checkpoint.

title: Generate OS-ICSD-oxide test set oxidation state predictions
action: Load the trained OS-ICSD-oxide BERTOS model, run inference on the OS-ICSD-oxide test set, and output per-atom predicted oxidation states alongside true labels.
description: Raw per-atom site predictions for the oxide-specific test set; the primary artifact for recomputing headline accuracy on oxides.
output_schema: Columns: composition (string), element (string), true_oxidation_state (int), predicted_oxidation_state (int). One row per atom site in the oxide test set.

title: Compute OS-ICSD-oxide evaluation metrics
action: Using the generated oxide predictions, compute overall site-level accuracy, compound-level accuracy, and per-element site-level accuracies, and write the results to a JSON file.
description: Summary metrics for the oxide evaluation, including per-element breakdown.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: overall_site_accuracy (float, percent), compound_level_accuracy (float, percent), per_element_site_accuracy (object mapping element symbol to float percent).
